triggerReasons.message: High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Bug, regression, security/auth/session, benchmark, or explicit behavior-change work should have red evidence.
Broad or absolute scope wording should have scope clarification before future enforcement.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: The registered red regression passes after staging bin targets are validated before old-dist eviction. Missing or syntactically invalid package manifests remain benign, while non-absence read failures abort without replacing the working dist. Doctor emits the healthy contract marker only when the global package, PATH-selected command, declared bin-target realpath, compiled version, and host executable contract agree. POSIX validates executable access; Windows validates the actual npm command shim and uses encoded PowerShell LiteralPath remediation that preserves spaces, apostrophes, and percent tokens. Capability skips and zero-assertion paths cannot emit the must PASS selector.

note: B-e256 fail-closed cross-platform contract after RI-006 and RI-007: stable selectors bind staging validation, PATH/package agreement, target containment, actual Windows shim validation, and host-safe remediation without universal POSIX mode claims.
